import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
import exact
# self-loop measurements
tests = [
    ({'groups':1,'jitter_ps':[0],'measurements':[[0,0,3,5]]}, 'inconsistent'),
    ({'groups':1,'jitter_ps':[0],'measurements':[[0,0,-5,-3]]}, 'inconsistent'),
    ({'groups':1,'jitter_ps':[0],'measurements':[[0,0,-2,4]]}, 'ok'),
    ({'groups':2,'jitter_ps':[1,1],'measurements':[[0,1,5,5],[1,0,-5,-5]]}, 'ok'),
    ({'groups':2,'jitter_ps':[1,1],'measurements':[[0,1,5,5],[1,0,-6,-6]]}, 'inconsistent'),
    ({'groups':3,'jitter_ps':[0,0,0],'measurements':[[0,1,0,0],[1,2,0,0],[2,0,0,0]]}, 'ok'),
    ({'groups':3,'jitter_ps':[0,0,0],'measurements':[[0,1,1,1],[1,2,1,1],[2,0,1,1]]}, 'inconsistent'),
    ({'groups':4,'jitter_ps':[0,0,0,0],'measurements':[[0,1,-100,100],[1,2,-100,100],[2,3,-100,100],[3,0,50,100]]}, 'ok'),
]
for prof, exp in tests:
    c = exact.Calibration(prof)
    got = c.status
    art = c.artifact()
    print(prof['measurements'], '->', got, art if got=='inconsistent' else '')
    assert got == exp, (prof, exp, got)
    # audit the artifact
    fab = {'n':1,'interval_ns':1,'slice_ns':1,'offset_ns':0,'drift_ppb':[0],'heat':[],'anchors':[[0,0,1]],'links':[],'slices':[[]],'blackouts':[],'guards_ns':[0],'reconfig_ns':0}
    r = exact.audit(prof, fab, art)
    assert r['valid'] == True, (prof, r)
    # verify the cycle manually
    if got == 'inconsistent':
        K = prof['groups']; meas=[tuple(m) for m in prof['measurements']]
        assert exact._check_cycle(art['cycle'], K, meas)
        # total weight
        tot = 0
        for e in art['cycle']:
            i, d = divmod(e,2)
            a,b,lo,hi = meas[i]
            tot += hi if d==0 else -lo
        print('   cycle weight', tot, 'len', len(art['cycle']))
print('OK')
